messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — I need to swap my Wed 10:30 release slot for runtime v1.9.2 -> v1.10. Customer meeting overlapped. No infra changes, only model cache invalidation + config bump. Smoke checklist below. Can someone take the slot and own rollback if needed?

Smoke steps:
```
# verify canary
curl -sS https://canary.runtime.redwood/api/health | jq .status
# smoke deploy
kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:v1.10
runtimesmoke --env=prod --timeout 2m
``` 
Feature flag: `runtime_v1_10`
Expected impact: no downtime, minimal latency changes. If you take it, please confirm you'll run smoke at 10:15 and hold till 11:00.

Jon: I can take it. I've merged the release branch and rebased the config. I'll run smoke at 10:15 and stay oncall until 11:00. @Sasha can you be rollback owner if my smoke fails? :raising_hand:

Sasha: Yep, I can be rollback owner. Rollback playbook in runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/runtime-rollback
Rollback cmd: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=42`

Kevin: Quick Q — did the canary eval show any tokenization/regression risk? Any perf numbers?

Maria: Canary perf looked stable — p50 + p95 within 2% of prod. Eval suite passed on the core prompt set. I'll attach the perf gist after this thread.

deploy-bot: slot-change processed — Wed 10:30 reassigned to Jon. Reminder: upload smoke logs to /releases/1718001234/logs and tag the PR with `release-claimed`.

Jon: Taking slot. Will post smoke results here. :rocket:
